'''Zombie Supplier Station''' is a blueprint that allows a [[zombie]] to transport the materials required by workstations and collect the finished products, placing them in chests.

== Obtaining ==

* Can be build in:
** {{Blueprint|Yard|text=no}} [[Yard]]
** {{Blueprint|Home|text=no}} [[Home]] (needs [[Kitchen II]], not [[Zombie Assistant]])
** {{Blueprint|Alchemy Lab|text=no}} [[Alchemy Lab]]
